vo.text: The whole feature lives on one screen. Here is what each of its four regions is telling you.
vo.next_text: Start with the toolbar. Its left side identifies where you are: the site name, and a course selector that only appears when the site has more than one Lynx course.

vo.next_text: Each sprinkler of a station scanned in the past seven days is a pin. A pin scanned today is coloured by its measured VWC against the four moisture bands in the legend, and a pin last scanned on an earlier day is drawn clear.
